result.reasoning_summary: The commit correctly implements FW-MCP-05 fail-closed health and kill-switch admission. Core safety-state configuration uses an immutable frozen dataclass with validation guards; HEALTHY+ENGAGED is the sole admissible combination enforced before any request tracking, quota mutation, or evidence audit. Fail-closed behavior is deterministic: malformed state values raise at dataclass instantiation, unsafe state combinations raise at admission time before internal state mutation (checked before pending_request_ids, admitted_request_ids, admission_counts, and audit). Backward compatibility is maintained via optional parameters (require_safe_state defaults False); existing code and legacy tests remain unaffected. Comprehensive test coverage includes: valid admission with state logging, parameterized rejection of all unsafe combinations with zero-mutation verification, malformed input rejection, and legacy mode. Thread safety is guaranteed by lock-protected check. Audit trail captures health and kill-switch states. No kill-switch clearing, tool execution, connection handling, transport changes, credentials, filesystem, shell, deployment, or response authority are present. Patch is narrow (77 insertions across safety state + tests + status docs), deterministic, and reviewable.</reasoning_summary>
